theater: 長江中游鄂州下游沙陽、新城

battle.name: 沙陽、新城之戰
battle.theater: 長江中游鄂州下游沙陽、新城
battle.brief: 至元十一年（1274）冬，伯顏部蒙古軍攻克鄂州後沿長江東下，攻破鄂州下游的沙陽與新城兩處宋軍江防，長江中游門戶洞開。卡面的拜占庭希臘火為銅管噴射的燃燒劑，此役未見實物，其同類兵器卻以宋軍猛火油與蒙古軍火毯火球的形式出現在江防與舟師之中。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 至元十一年（1274）冬天，戰場落在長江中游南岸，自鄂州（今湖北武漢一帶）下溯到沙陽（今湖北赤壁、舊蒲圻，陸水入江之口）與新城（在今湖北黃石、陽新方向）一線，這是南宋江南西路最後一道還成體面的江防。交戰的一方是元軍：元世祖忽必烈自襄陽沿漢水順流而下，伯顏統前鋒，阿里海牙副之，阿朮、董文炳、張弘範等各領一部；蒙古騎兵仍是骨幹，但自襄陽以下全程靠水，兵員、攻城器具與糧秣全賴漢水與長江水運，舟師從此成為這支部隊的要害。另一方是南宋：鄂州、江州、潭州一線由荊湖安撫司與各處都統司分守，名義上的兵額不少，調度卻慢；朝中以丞相賈似道總攬軍政，江防的實際指揮則分散在幾位守將手上。雙方隔江對峙：元軍要把騎兵優勢改造成水陸兩棲的攻勢，宋軍要靠城郭、樓船與江上的火器拖住對手。於是這不是一場野戰，而是一場爭江面、爭岸線、爭補給的攻守。
countriesEn: The winter of 1274 put the battlefield on the southern bank of the middle Yangtze, from Yuezhou (modern Wuhan in Hubei) downstream to Saiyang (modern Chibi, formerly Puki in Hubei, at the mouth of the Lushui) and Xincheng (toward modern Huangshi and Yangxin in Hubei) — the last reasonably intact river defence line of the Southern Song's Jiangnan West Circuit. One belligerent was the Yuan army: Kublai Khan came down the Han River from Xiangyang with the water carrying him, Bayan commanded the vanguard, Arighaya was his deputy, and Aju, Dong Wenbing, Zhang Hongfan and others led separate columns. Mongol cavalry remained the backbone, but from Xiangyang onward everything moved on water — men, siege gear and grain all travelled by the Han and the Yangtze — and the river fleet became the heart of this army. The other side was the Southern Song: Yuezhou, Jiangzhou and Tanzhou were held by the Jinghu Pacification Office and the various regional commands, with large paper strength but slow movements; at the centre of the court sat the chancellor Jia Sidao, who took charge of military affairs, while the actual command of the river line was split among several defending generals. The two sides faced each other across the water: the Yuan needed to convert cavalry superiority into an amphibious advance, and the Song needed walls, tower ships and fire weapons on the river to hold the other side off. This was therefore not a field battle but a struggle for the river, for the banks, and for supply.
people: 留下姓名的，蒙古一側最清楚。伯顏出身巴鄰氏貴族，是忽必烈最倚重的統帥之一，這一路他自襄陽、樊城打起，順漢水而東，攻克鄂州後直取沙陽、新城，最後又統兵下崖山，為元朝畫上宋室的句號。阿里海牙是畏兀兒人，副將；阿朮是兀良合台之子，領舟師深入江西，準備在主力東下時抄宋廷的側後。最關鍵的一個漢人是劉整——原為南宋沿江制置副使，襄樊失守後歸元，力主造船、習水、建城，元軍的水戰能力幾乎是他一手調教出來的，他於至元十二年前後病卒。董文炳、董文用、董文虎兄弟出自真定，是蒙古帳下的漢人統帥，張弘範亦出自這一批。宋方的主角是丞相賈似道，他以十三萬精兵赴援鄂州；鄂州守將高達力戰拒守，城陷前病歿軍中；荊湖安撫使夏貴後來以鄂州、江州降元；潭州守將李庭芝於次年正月城破之際死節。襄樊守將呂文煥在前一年已降，李庭芝、張必、范文虎諸人先後敗降，構成本線上完整的降將名單。
peopleEn: Those whose names survive are clearest on the Yuan side. Bayan came from the Baarin aristocracy and was one of Kublai's most trusted commanders; from this campaign he fought at Xiangyang and Fancheng, ran down the Han River, took Yuezhou and then struck at Saiyang and Xincheng, and finally led the army that ended the Song at Yashan, closing the dynasty's account in the Yuan chronicle. Arighaya was a Uyghur and served as deputy; Aju, son of Uriyangtai, took the river fleet deep into Jiangxi, ready to strike the Song flank once the main column moved east. The most important Han was Liu Zheng, once a Southern Song river command deputy who came over to the Yuan after Xiangyang fell. He pressed for shipbuilding, water drill and the raising of siege works, and the Yuan's water-war capability was in large part his creation; he died of illness around the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era. The brothers Dong Wenbing, Dong Wenyong and Dong Wenhu came from Zhending and were Han commanders in Mongol service, and Zhang Hongfan belonged to that same group. On the Song side the principal figure was the chancellor Jia Sidao, who marched to the relief of Yuezhou with 130,000 picked troops; Yuezhou's defending general Gao Da held the city by force, dying of illness in the camp as it fell; the Jinghu pacification commissioner Xia Gui later surrendered Yuezhou and Jiangzhou to the Yuan; and the governor of Tanzhou, Li Tingzhi, died at his post when that city fell in the first month of the following year. Lü Wenhuan, who had commanded Xiangyang, had already surrendered the year before, and under him Li Tingzhi, Zhang Bi, Fan Wenhu and the rest surrendered in turn, making up the complete roll of turncoats along this front.
kits: 卡面這件拜占庭希臘火，載於七世紀，是配在銅管裡的燃燒劑，靠銅管與壓力把液態的燃燒物噴出，落在水上仍能繼續燃燒，帝國把配方視為最高機密，最後隨帝國覆亡而失傳。它的戰史位置在防守方的城頭與水面上：八世紀初阿拉伯軍隊兩度打到君士坦丁堡外，都被這種火器與投石機聯手擋在城下。就1274年這條戰線而言，希臘火本身沒有出現在長江上，記載裡也找不到任何一件；真正與它同類同功的，是宋軍的猛火油。《武經總要》記了以皮囊盛油、竹管噴射的做法，陳規《守城錄》等守城文獻亦載以火油灌灼來犯之敵，同樣用在江防與水戰：守軍把燃燒物灌進浮筏順流放下，或在城頭向下方的舟師噴射；元軍那邊的火器則以火毯、火球、火箭為主，配合從襄陽運下的攻城砲與撞車，用來燒毀城門與城頭器械。希臘火的技術是否經蒙古西征打通歐亞的通道東傳，學界一直有這樣的推測，十三世紀中葉蒙古汗國與拜占庭確有使節往來，但就沙陽、新城這兩處江防而言，沒有任何文獻可以指認它。
kitsEn: The card shows Byzantine Greek fire, recorded in the seventh century: a burning charge carried in bronze tubes, forced out under pressure and able to keep burning even on water. The empire treated the formula as its highest secret, and it was finally lost when the empire itself fell. Its place in history is on the walls and the water of the defending side: when the Arab armies reached Constantinople twice in the early eighth century, they were thrown back in front of the city by exactly this weapon working together with counterweight engines. In the campaign of 1274 on this front, Greek fire itself never appeared on the Yangtze, and no trace of it can be found in the record; the device genuinely comparable to it in function was the Song menghuoyou, burning oil. The Wujing Zongyao describes oil held in skin bags and forced out through bamboo pipes, and the Record of the Defence of Cities by Chen Gui and other city-defence writers record burning oil poured and sprayed onto attackers, again in river defence and in action on the water: the defenders loaded burning material onto floating rafts and let them drift down, or sprayed down from the wall onto the ships below. On the Yuan side the fire weapons were chiefly fire blankets, fire balls and fire arrows, used together with siege engines and rams carried down from Xiangyang to burn gates and the equipment on the walls. Whether the technology of Greek fire reached the east along the channels opened by the Mongol conquests has long been a matter of speculation in the west; there were indeed envoys between the Mongol khanates and Byzantium in the mid thirteenth century, but for the river defences of Saiyang and Xincheng no document can point to it.
tactics: 這場戰爭的樣貌完全由水決定。元軍的戰法是順流而下：舟師在前，兩岸騎兵護衛，遇城即攻，攻不下便連營圍住，等後續的攻城砲與糧船跟上來；不戰而取城，是這支部隊在漢水流域養成的習慣。劉整所授的水戰之術重點在兩件事：一是造得下能在長江裡走的大船，二是讓騎兵和舟師彼此配合——船兵先擾亂守軍，騎兵再衝。宋軍則完全倚城：鄂州一城拖住元軍數月，高達以偏師拒守，靠的是城頭的弓弩、砲石與火器；沙陽、新城同樣是沿江的關隘，防守方把主力放在城與水寨，舟隊巡江，燃燒類兵器用來封住江面，阻止蒙古舟師靠岸。戰局真正的轉折在援軍：賈似道率十三萬人至鄂州後，伯顏故意向潭州方向退去，把宋軍主力引出鄂州，既解了圍又拉開了兩軍的距離；宋軍不敢追，隊形一鬆，元軍便趁勢分兵取沙陽、新城。冬季水淺，舟師在江汊與淺灘處要靠人纖牽牛拉，推進並不快，這也讓雙方都沒有立刻分出勝負。
tacticsEn: The shape of this war was decided entirely by the water. The Yuan method was to come down the river: the fleet in front, cavalry guarding the banks, and every town encountered attacked on the way; where a city did not fall, the army simply camped around it in a chain until the siege engines and the grain boats caught up. Taking towns without a battle had become the habit this army had formed in the Han River basin. The water drill that Liu Zheng taught turned on two things: the ability to build large vessels that could work the Yangtze, and the ability to make cavalry and fleet cooperate — the ship's men harrying the defenders first, the horsemen charging in behind. The Song fought entirely from their walls: Yuezhou alone held the Yuan for months, Gao Da resisting with a fraction of the army by bow, stone and fire from the wall; Saiyang and Xincheng were in the same case, river strongholds whose garrisons were kept in the town and in water camps, with boats patrolling the channel and incendiaries used to seal the surface against the Yuan fleet coming alongside. The real turning point was the relief army. When Jia Sidao arrived at Yuezhou with 130,000 men, Bayan deliberately withdrew toward Tanzhou, drawing the Song main force out of Yuezhou, relieving the siege and pulling the two armies apart; the Song did not dare pursue, the formation slackened, and the Yuan used the opening to detach columns for Saiyang and Xincheng. In winter the shallows were a hindrance: the fleet had to be towed by men and oxen through the branches and shoals, and progress was slow, which kept the outcome from resolving itself quickly.
data: 可核的數字不多，但骨架大致清楚。襄陽、樊城自1267年前後被圍，到1273年九月樊城陷落，前後六年，是元軍第一次遇到真正的江南水網。1274年十月忽必烈抵鄂州，十一月鄂州城破、高達死，十二月伯顏部取沙陽、新城，1275年正月潭州陷、李庭芝死；再往後是1276年二月臨安出降、1279年崖山覆宋。援軍的規模，賈似道出動的兵，兩《宋史》一系都寫作精兵十三萬，另有十五萬之說，都當作量級看待。元軍的總數沒有可靠統計，各家多作數十萬之說；舟師的規模同樣只有概數，可確認的是自襄陽起便備有大批戰船，後來沿同一條航道下到潭州與江州。距離上，襄陽到沙陽走漢水與長江水路約六百餘公里，鄂州到沙陽約二百公里，兩座城彼此相隔數十里，屬同一段江防。糧食方面，元軍入宋境後就地取給，浙江、江西一路尚可支應，但冬季淺水與運糧船隊的遲滯，成了制約他們推進速度的實數。至於守軍人數、攻城所用器械的具體數目，現存記載殘缺，只宜說是數千至萬餘的量級。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, but the skeleton is clear. Xiangyang and Fancheng were under siege from around 1267 until the fall of Fancheng in the ninth month of 1273, six years in all — the first time the Yuan had met a real southern water network. Kublai reached Yuezhou in the tenth month of 1274; the city fell in the eleventh month and Gao Da died; in the twelfth month Bayan's men took Saiyang and Xincheng; in the first month of 1275 Tanzhou fell and Li Tingzhi died; then the surrender of Lin'an in the second month of 1276 and the end of the Song at Yashan in 1279. The scale of the relief force, the picked troops Jia Sidao led out, is given in the Song histories as 130,000, with a variant figure of 150,000; both should be read as orders of magnitude. There is no reliable count of the Yuan host, most sources speak of several hundred thousand; the fleet is known only in general terms, though it is certain that a large number of war vessels were built from Xiangyang onward and later ran down the same channel to Tanzhou and Jiangzhou. As for distance, some six hundred and odd kilometres of river road separate Xiangyang from Saiyang, and about two hundred from Yuezhou to Saiyang, while the two towns stand a few tens of li apart and belong to the same stretch of river defence. On supply, once inside Song territory the Yuan took grain on the spot, and the Zhejiang and Jiangxi lines could in general provide it, but the winter shallows and the slow progress of the grain fleet were real constraints on how fast they could advance. Figures for the defending garrisons and for the numbers of siege engines cannot be checked, and can only be given as a range of several thousand to rather more than ten thousand.
cause: 打起來的緣由，遠近各有。第一層是邊界：宋端平年間收復河南淮西的舊地，隨後又失；四川釣魚城守到十三世紀末，荊湖與兩淮的邊防在1240年代之後一直是拉鋸態勢，蒙古與南宋在邊境上互相消耗了半個多世紀。第二層是忽必烈選的時機：襄陽六年圍城，到1273年冬樊城陷落，漢水門戶打開，宋廷再沒有可以倚仗的江防縱深，於是元廷決定分三路——自雲南出廣西、自襄陽沿漢水下湖南、另遣舟師趨江西——要把南宋一次滅掉。第三層是宋廷自己的病：賈似道以鹽法、專賣斂財，靠增加軍額和拖欠的糧餉養出龐大名冊上的兵，一旦開戰，紙面數字與可用之兵完全對不上；朝廷對前線的調度又屢屢更換，援兵到了也不肯貿然進攻。第四層是軍事技術：蒙古人學會了造船與水戰，攻城有了回回砲，漢水流域六年下來，攻城與守城的差距已經倒向元軍一方。沙陽、新城之戰，正是這四層壓力同時收緊的產物。
causeEn: The reasons for the war lie at several distances. The first is the frontier. The Song recovered the old lands of Henan and the western Huai during the Duanping years and lost them again; Diaoyu City in Sichuan held out into the late thirteenth century; and the borders of Jinghu and the Two Huai had been grinding against each other since the 1240s, the Mongols and the Southern Song wearing one another down for more than half a century. The second is the moment Kublai chose. After six years of siege at Xiangyang and the fall of Fancheng in the winter of 1273, the Han River gateway stood open and the Song had no depth of river defence left to fall back on, so the Yuan court resolved to move in three columns — out of Yunnan into Guangxi, down the Han from Xiangyang into Hunan, and a separate fleet into Jiangxi — to finish the Southern Song at one stroke. The third is the Song court's own disease. Jia Sidao raised money through the salt monopoly and other exactions, and kept a paper army in the field on an expanded roll and on unpaid rations; once war came, the numbers on paper and the men actually available had no relation to each other, and the court repeatedly changed its commanders, so that even when the relief troops arrived they would not attack. The fourth is military technique. The Mongols had learned to build ships and fight on water, and they had siege engines including the Huihui pao, and six years in the Han River basin had turned the balance of attack and defence decisively toward the Yuan. The battle of Saiyang and Xincheng is the product of all four pressures closing at once.
impact: 沙陽、新城失守的直接後果，是長江中游的門戶再也關不上。蒙古軍取得沿江的據點之後，舟師可以不停靠岸，騎兵可以隨時登陸，江西與兩浙的平原便整片敞開；1275年潭州、袁州、撫州相繼易手，1276年臨安出降，元廷在江南的統治由此落定。軍心上，荊湖一線的宋軍系統在半年之內瓦解，高達死、夏貴降、李庭芝死，剩下的是一長串隨之投降的將領，荊湖子弟兵從此大量編入蒙古軍隊，這批人後來成為元軍水陸兩棲作戰的骨幹。技術上，這條線也讓蒙古完成了從草原部落到江海水軍的轉身：能造大船、能打水戰、能沿江運糧，後來1280年代東征日本、1290年代征爪哇，都是沿著同一套水陸並進的辦法；而在江南的技術層面，燃燒類兵器也出現分岔：中國的猛火油走的是皮囊加竹管的噴射路子，與拜占庭以銅管承壓的路子形似而制異，並無直接相通的確證。戰爭的另一面，是江南的航運、鹽運與市鎮貿易在元朝的秩序下重新編排，運河與長江成了帝國的血管。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the loss of Saiyang and Xincheng was that the middle Yangtze could never be closed again. With river bases in hand the Yuan fleet could put in anywhere and the cavalry could land at will, and the plains of Jiangxi and the Two Zhe opened to the full width of the invasion; Tanzhou, Yuanzhou and Fuzhou changed hands in turn through 1275, Lin'an surrendered in 1276, and the Yuan settlement in the south was settled. Morally, the Song military system of the Jinghu region came apart within half a year — Gao Da dead, Xia Gui surrendered, Li Tingzhi dead, and after them a long roll of generals who surrendered in turn; large numbers of Jinghu troops were folded into the Mongol army, and they became the backbone of the Yuan's amphibious operations. Technically, this front also completed the Mongols' turn from steppe riders into a river fleet: they could build great ships, fight on water, and move grain by river, and the expeditions against Japan in the 1280s and against Java in the 1290s both ran on the same combined water-and-land method. At the level of technique in the south, the incendiary weapons also forked: the Chinese menghuoyou followed the skin-bag-and-bamboo-pipe route, similar in appearance but different in construction from the Byzantine bronze-tube pressure vessel, and there is no solid evidence connecting the two directly. The other side of the war was the reordering of navigation, salt transport and market trade in the Jiangnan under Yuan rule, with the canals and the Yangtze turned into the arteries of the empire.
result: 點到為止的結局，是沙陽、新城兩處江防相繼失守，而元軍至此已經完成對長江中游的突破。伯顏乘勢進取潭州，1275年正月城破，李庭芝與守軍死於城中；賈似道懼怕，一面請和，遣使與元營議約，約成而元廷內部有人主張不受其降；元軍則以借期收降為名緩兵，轉瞬再進。之後是江州、德化、安慶、池州、太平一路失守，1275年冬兵鋒抵達江浙，1276年二月臨安出降，宋室流寓海上，1279年崖山之役，宋室覆亡。回頭看沙陽、新城本身：兩城此後成為元軍東進的跳板與江西的江防節點，而它們在宋代的名字與地位，則逐漸淹沒在元代的地名沿革裡。這場戰爭的史料本身很薄，戰役過程多靠元《世祖本紀》與伯顏等將領傳的零星句子、加上宋人追述襄鄂之役的文字拼湊而成，兵員、器械、日期都只能得到大概；能確定的，是它標誌著南宋長江防線的崩潰，也標誌著蒙古帝國第一次真正駛入長江。
resultEn: The upshot was that the two river strongholds fell in turn and the Yuan had broken the middle Yangtze. Bayan pressed on to Tanzhou, which fell in the first month of 1275 with Li Tingzhi and the garrison dying in the city; Jia Sidao, frightened, sent envoys to make terms, and the agreement was made even as voices in the Yuan court argued whether to accept his submission; the Yuan then used the pretence of allowing a date for surrender to gain time and advanced again. After that came Jiangzhou, Dehua, Anqing, Chizhou and Taiping, then in the winter of 1275 the banners reached Jiangzhe, and in the second month of 1276 Lin'an surrendered, the Song court drifting away to the sea, until Yashan in 1279 ended the Song house. Looking back at Saiyang and Xincheng themselves: from then on they were the stepping stones of the Yuan advance and nodes of the Jiangxi river defence, while their Song names and standing were gradually buried under the succession of Yuan place-names. The sources for this war are thin: the course of the fighting has to be pieced together from stray sentences in the Yuan Veritable Records of Shizu and in the biographies of generals such as Bayan, together with Song writing on the campaigns of Xiangyang and Yuezhou, and the men, the machines and the dates can only be given in rough outline. What is certain is that it marks the collapse of the Song's Yangtze defence line, and the first time the Mongol empire truly sailed onto the Yangtze.
